title: ARC-170 starfighter (Star Wars, Revenge of the Sith)

sources.title: List of Star Wars starfighters: ARC-170 (Wikipedia)
Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (Wikipedia)

intro: The ARC-170 is a fictional heavy fighter of the Republic in Revenge of the Sith, with a crew of three: pilot, co-pilot and front gunner, and a tail gunner. Its wings split open (S-foils) like an X-wing's. The pilot and co-pilot sit one behind the other, and the tail gunner has his own position at the back.

areas.name: Pilot's panel
areas.text: Displays and controls in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Pilot's panel
panels.text: Screens and the wing control in front of the pilot.
panels.context: The pilot flies and fires the forward guns while the others help.

controls.name: Forward displays
controls.text: Screens in front of the pilot show the sensor and targeting pictures.
controls.context: They help the pilot find targets in the big space battle of the film.

controls.name: S-foil control

positions.name: ATTACK
positions.text: The wings are open; the fighter is ready to fight.

positions.name: CRUISE
positions.text: The wings are closed for normal travel.

controls.text: This control opens the wings to the attack position or closes them for cruising.
controls.context: Like on the X-wing, open wings show the fighter is ready to fight.

areas.name: Crew stations behind the pilot
areas.text: The co-pilot's seat and the tail gunner's position.

panels.name: Co-pilot / gunner seat
panels.text: The second crew member's seat behind the pilot.
panels.context: The co-pilot helps with navigation and the weapons.

controls.name: Co-pilot station
controls.text: The co-pilot sits behind the pilot and helps with navigation and the weapons.
controls.context: Sharing the work lets the pilot concentrate on flying.

panels.name: Tail gunner position
panels.text: A rear-facing gun position at the back of the hull.
panels.context: The tail gunner protects the fighter from enemies behind.

controls.name: Tail guns
controls.text: Laser cannons at the back that point backwards, worked by the tail gunner.
controls.context: They cover the area behind the fighter that the pilot cannot see.

areas.name: Flight controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight controls
panels.text: The hand controls in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They fly the fighter and fire the forward cannons.

controls.name: Flight controls
controls.text: The flight controls tip the nose up and down and roll the fighter left and right.
controls.context: The pilot flies while the co-pilot and the tail gunner look after the rest.

controls.name: Fire control
controls.text: A control on the flight grips fires the forward cannons.
controls.context: The tail guns are fired by the tail gunner, not the pilot.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: This stands for the control that sets the craft's speed.
panels.context: Revenge of the Sith does not show this control clearly; the catalog adds it so a joystick set has a place for the speed.

controls.name: Throttle (not clearly shown)
controls.text: This axis stands for the craft's speed: forward for faster, back for slower. The screen does not show where the real control sits, so its place is a guess.
controls.context: On a stick and throttle set this is the throttle lever; in the work itself the pilot is mostly seen with both hands on the flight controls.
